papers.title: Hidden chiral signatures in ferroaxial K2Zr(PO4)2
papers.abstract: We use first-principles calculations and multipole analyses to demonstrate the relationship between ferroaxiality and chirality in the prototypical ferroaxial material K2Zr(PO4)2. Using the atomic-site electric toroidal monopole as a measure of electronic chirality in real space, we show that, while the paraxial phase of K2Zr(PO4)2 is non-chiral, the ferroaxial phase is antiferro-chiral. By applying an electric field, we induce a ferri-chiral state with net electronic chirality which is opposite for opposite underlying ferroaxial domains and can be tuned by the direction and strength of the electric field. Associated with the real-space induced chirality, we find a distinct response in momentum space, with induced non-zero components in the Berry curvature dipole tensor that switch sign between opposite ferri-chiral domains. Our findings therefore reveal hidden chirality in ferroaxial materials in both real and momentum space.

papers.title: Exponential Capacity in Multilayer Hetero-Associative Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Exponential Hopfield networks store a number of patterns that grows exponentially with the number of neurons, and in their classical formulation they are auto-associative: they complete a corrupted copy of a memory into the memory itself. Many of the tasks one wants such a network to perform are instead hetero-associative, mapping a cue to a different target. We introduce and analyse an exponential neural network of $L$ layers of $N$ binary neurons, each layer carrying its own dataset, whose energy is an exponential of the product of the per-layer Mattis overlaps, so that it is minimised precisely when every layer retrieves the pattern of the same index; the stored association must be a surjective function of the cue, and we show why nothing else can be stored at all. A cavity/signal-to-noise analysis, made exact at leading order by a large-deviation evaluation of the noise, shows that the aligned hetero-associative state is a fixed point of the zero-temperature dynamics up to a number of stored patterns $P_c\sim e^{Nρ_L}$, exponential in the layer size, with an explicit rate $ρ_L$ that grows like $L\log 2$; enlarging the basins of attraction lowers the rate but never destroys its exponential character. Comparing the theory with structured data we find that the exponential capacity and the predicted basins survive correlated, many-to-one patterns: the network is a near-perfect content-addressable memory. The same closed forms describe, without refitting, a synthetic manifold, real T-cell-receptor/epitope triples and natural-language intent data, so the mechanism is domain-universal. Generalisation to unseen cues, though significantly above chance, stays below memorisation, and it is the geometry of the encoding, rather than the data domain, that sets how far above chance it reaches. In this family, exponential storage and strong generalisation are distinct capabilities.

papers.title: Elastodynamics from Eulerian Poisson-bracket formalism: application to chiral odd solids
papers.abstract: The Poisson-bracket (PB) formalism is widely used to derive dynamics of coarse-grained (CG) fields to capture large-scale physics, extending the role of PBs in classical particle mechanics to macroscopic fields. It has been applied to fluctuations in critical phenomena, hydrodynamics of liquid crystals, liquid crystal elastomers, tissues, and the emergence of odd viscosity from spinning particles. The PB formalism can be formulated in either the Lagrangian framework, using reference space, or the Eulerian framework, using real space. Conventionally, the Lagrangian formulation is used for elastic solids, and the Eulerian one for fluids. However, growing interest in Eulerian descriptions of solids has emerged for phenomena naturally defined in real space, such as viscoelastic responses, moving interfaces, and field-induced structural changes in particles. Here we develop a systematic formulation for applying the Eulerian PB formalism to elastic systems with potentials typically written in Lagrangian space, and clarify its consistency with the Lagrangian counterpart. We show that the Eulerian formulation generates additional nonlinearities absent in the Lagrangian framework. Such nonlinearities originate from CG volume changes under coordinate transformation and from particle flow across neighboring CG volumes. They must be retained when nonlinear effects are important. To illustrate, we study chiral active solids of finite-sized particles, where active torques drive internal particle rotations and generate geometric nonlinearities. These nonlinearities give rise to the odd elastic modulus, which non-reciprocally couples two different shear modes in stress-strain response. By recovering this modulus directly from the Eulerian PB formalism, we demonstrate its ability to capture emergent nonlinear elastic behavior in driven active solids, whose stresses are naturally measured in real space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“Poisson-bracket (PB) formalism”“formulation”“derive dynamics”等理论推导关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：弹性系统（特别是手性活性固体）的粗粒化动力学，重点研究有限尺寸粒子在主动力矩驱动下产生的几何非线性弹性行为，以及由此涌现的奇弹性模量（odd elastic modulus）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 欧拉泊松括号形式体系在应用于弹性系统时会产生拉格朗日框架中不存在的额外非线性项，这些非线性项源于粗粒化体积在坐标变换下的变化及粒子在相邻粗粒化体积间的流动；在手性活性固体中，这些非线性项直接导致奇弹性模量的出现，该模量非互易地耦合两种剪切模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：欧拉泊松括号形式体系在应用于弹性系统时会产生拉格朗日框架中不存在的额外非线性项，这些非线性项源于粗粒化体积在坐标变换下的变化及粒子在相邻粗粒化体积间的流动；在手性活性固体中，这些非线性项直接导致奇弹性模量的出现，该模量非互易地耦合两种剪切模式。；创新点：首次系统性地将欧拉泊松括号形式体系应用于通常用拉格朗日空间势能描述的弹性系统，并明确揭示了欧拉框架中额外非线性项的来源及其物理意义；通过直接从欧拉形式体系恢复奇弹性模量，展示了该框架捕捉驱动活性固体中涌现非线性弹性行为的能力。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为欧拉泊松括号形式体系（Eulerian Poisson-bracket formalism），系统推导了该形式体系对弹性系统的应用，并与传统拉格朗日框架进行一致性对比；以手性活性固体（有限尺寸粒子受主动力矩驱动）为例进行具体分析。

papers.title: Ordered-to-disordered transfer learning with graph neural networks for formation-energy and HOMO-LUMO gap prediction in high-entropy perovskite oxides
papers.abstract: High-entropy perovskite oxides (HEPOs) represent a chemically complex class of materials with promising functional properties, yet their vast compositional space and, chemical/structural disorder pose significant challenge for accurate property prediction. Graph neural networks (GNNs) enable rapid exploration of materials space but are often limited by the availability of representative training data. Here, we investigate ordered-to-disordered transfer learning using GNNs for formation-energy and HOMO-LUMO gap prediction in HEPOs by transferring knowledge learned from chemically ordered perovskites. Four representative GNN models, including CGCNN, GATGNN, ALIGNN and M3GNet are evaluated to understand the role of structural representations, spanning pairwise two-body and angular three-body interactions in transfer performance. We find strong property-dependent transfer behavior: formation-energy prediction transfers effectively to disordered HEPOs, whereas HOMO-LUMO gap prediction shows limited transferability due to its sensitivity to local chemical environments. Incorporating a small HEPO-specific training dataset substantially improves HOMO-LUMO gap prediction. Representation-level analysis using UMAP further highlights the importance of encoding three-body geometric information such as in ALIGNN for capturing complex structure-property relationships and improving transferability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用图神经网络（GNNs）、UMAP降维分析等计算与机器学习方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：高熵钙钛矿氧化物（HEPOs），具体预测其形成能（formation energy）和HOMO-LUMO能隙。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 形成能预测可从有序钙钛矿有效迁移至无序HEPOs，而HOMO-LUMO能隙预测的迁移性较差，因其对局域化学环境敏感；引入少量HEPO特定训练数据可显著改善能隙预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：形成能预测可从有序钙钛矿有效迁移至无序HEPOs，而HOMO-LUMO能隙预测的迁移性较差，因其对局域化学环境敏感；引入少量HEPO特定训练数据可显著改善能隙预测。；创新点：系统评估了不同GNN结构表示（两体vs三体相互作用）对有序→无序迁移学习效果的影响，并揭示了三体几何信息（如ALIGNN所编码的）对提升复杂结构-性质关系捕捉能力的关键作用。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。

papers.title: Delayed Formation of Landau Polaritons in Phase-Resolved THz Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Strong light-matter coupling gives rise to polaritons through coherent and periodic energy exchange between electromagnetic cavity fields and material excitations. While this interaction is typically inferred from spectral mode splitting, its dynamics remain largely unexplored. Here, using phase-resolved terahertz time-domain spectroscopy, we observe Rabi oscillations of Landau polaritons formed by coupling the cyclotron resonance in a GaAs/Al$_{0.36}$Ga$_{0.64}$As two-dimensional electron gas with Fabry-Perot cavity modes. By employing cross-polarized spectroscopy and magnetic-field differential, we resolve the temporal beating of the cyclotron resonance oscillations. Remarkably, we find that the Rabi oscillations do not start immediately after excitation of the cyclotron resonance, but after a delay corresponding to one cavity round-trip time. This demonstrates that the strong-coupling regime sets up only after the formation of the cavity mode field. Our results provide direct insight into the dynamics of hybrid light-matter states in the THz regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“phase-resolved terahertz time-domain spectroscopy”（相位分辨太赫兹时域光谱）这一实验手段，并描述了观测结果。；研究对象：GaAs/Al₀.₃₆Ga₀.₆₄As二维电子气中回旋共振与法布里-珀罗腔模耦合形成的朗道极化激元（Landau polaritons），属于太赫兹频段的强光-物质耦合体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 朗道极化激元的拉比振荡并非在回旋共振激发后立即开始，而是延迟了一个腔往返时间（one cavity round-trip time）后才建立。这表明强耦合状态只有在腔模场形成之后才得以确立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：朗道极化激元的拉比振荡并非在回旋共振激发后立即开始，而是延迟了一个腔往返时间（one cavity round-trip time）后才建立。这表明强耦合状态只有在腔模场形成之后才得以确立。；创新点：首次在时间域上直接观测到朗道极化激元拉比振荡的建立过程，并揭示其延迟起始于一个腔往返时间——这一动态细节是传统基于谱线劈裂推断强耦合所无法获得的。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。

papers.title: Valley- and Orbital-Controlled 2D Chern Insulators Without Spin-orbit Interaction
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical study of orbital-induced topological phase transitions in a two-dimensional lattice model with staggered potential $(Δ)$ and orbital coupling $(λ)$ competing with the hopping strength. By tuning these parameters, two gap-closing mechanisms emerge: valley closure at $\mathbf{K}$ and $\mathbf{K'}$ for $λ=\pmΔ$, and a $\mathbfΓ$-point closure at $λ=\pm\sqrt{Δ^2+9t_0^{2}}$. Their interplay defines a topological window in which the Berry curvature localizes near a single valley, yielding a quantized anomalous Hall conductivity ($σ_{xy}=e^{2}/h$) and Chern number ($C=1$). These results demonstrate orbital-driven Chern insulating behavior without spin-orbit coupling. The resulting phase diagram captures the transition from trivial to topological phases and suggests practical routes for orbital engineering in tunable lattice systems.

papers.title: Substrate contact angle governs microgel shape, stiffness and deposition pattern
papers.abstract: Soft microgels are widely used as deformable building blocks for two-dimensional assemblies, yet solid substrates are often treated as passive supports after interfacial deposition. Here, we show that substrate wettability mechanically preconditions soft microgels before drying. Using in-liquid force-volume atomic force microscopy, we find that the same microgels adopt markedly different hydrated shapes and stiffness profiles depending on substrate contact angle: hydrophobic substrates induce spreading, flattening, and internal stiffening, whereas hydrophilic substrates preserve taller, softer microgels with smaller contact areas. These single-microgel states can explain how Langmuir-Blodgett-deposited monolayers respond during drying. On hydrophilic substrates, the observed assemblies are consistent with soft and weakly immobilized microgels rearranging under immersion-capillary forces, producing distinct corona-corona and core-core contact states and an apparent isostructural transition. On hydrophobic substrates, the flattened and stiffened microgels are more strongly immobilized, likely suppressing capillary-driven rearrangements and largely preserving the transferred interfacial assembly structure. These findings establish substrate-controlled microgel mechanics as the missing link between interfacial self-assembly and the final structures observed after transfer and drying.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用“in-liquid force-volume atomic force microscopy”进行实验测量，并观察Langmuir-Blodgett沉积单层在干燥过程中的行为。；研究对象：软微凝胶（soft microgels）在固体基底上的二维组装体系，具体研究基底润湿性（接触角）如何影响微凝胶在干燥前的形状、刚度及最终沉积结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基底润湿性在干燥前就机械性地预调节了软微凝胶的状态：疏水基底使微凝胶铺展、扁平化并内部变硬，而亲水基底则保持微凝胶更高、更软且接触面积更小；这些单颗粒状态差异决定了后续干燥过程中单层膜的重排行为与最终结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基底润湿性在干燥前就机械性地预调节了软微凝胶的状态：疏水基底使微凝胶铺展、扁平化并内部变硬，而亲水基底则保持微凝胶更高、更软且接触面积更小；这些单颗粒状态差异决定了后续干燥过程中单层膜的重排行为与最终结构。；创新点：将基底润湿性（接触角）确立为控制微凝胶力学状态的关键参数，并揭示其作为“界面自组装”与“转移干燥后最终结构”之间缺失环节的机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。

papers.title: Dissipation-enhanced vortex clustering in a compressible quantum fluid
papers.abstract: Vortex clustering is commonly associated with conservative two-dimensional quantum-fluid dynamics. Therefore, particle loss is mainly expected to limit clustering by shortening the time available for vortex correlations to develop. Here we show instead that particle loss can enhance transient vortex clustering beyond the conservative evolution. We numerically study freely decaying, confined two-dimensional condensates initialized with random distributions of vortices and antivortices, and find a pronounced nonmonotonic dependence of the maximum clustering on particle lifetime. The enhancement is strongest at intermediate particle-loss rates, where loss-induced background rarefaction and incompressible kinetic energy relaxation occur on comparable timescales. Our results identify a finite dynamical window, selected by linear particle loss, in which a confined compressible quantum fluid develops stronger same-sign vortex correlations than in the conservative limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“numerically study”（数值研究），属于数值模拟/计算研究。；研究对象：受限二维可压缩量子流体（玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体）中的涡旋-反涡旋系统，具体研究粒子损耗（线性粒子损失）对涡旋团簇化动力学的影响。

papers.title: Tuneable magnetic behaviour, electronic structure and nitrogen vacancy formation in Gd$_{x}$Sm$_{1-x}$N
papers.abstract: The rare earth nitrides are the only series of intrinsic ferromagnetic semiconductors where the interplay of spin and unquenched orbital angular momentum provides access to a range of magnetic behaviour. Furthermore, the magnetic properties can be finely tuned through the combination of multiple lanthanide ions in the nitride. Here we present a combined computational and experimental study on the electronic and magnetic properties of Gd$_x$Sm$_{1-x}$N and discuss the effect of cation substitution on the internal exchange field and band structure. We find that as the coercive field of Gd$_x$Sm$_{1-x}$N changes over orders of magnitude via cation substitution the internal exchange field changes by $\sim$20%. Control of these material properties is vital in the field of superconducting spintronics. Finally, motivated by an enhanced concentration of nitrogen vacancies in films with higher Sm content, we investigate computationally the formation of nitrogen vacancy defects in Gd$_x$Sm$_{1-x}$N finding that the formation energy is significantly reduced for vacancy sites adjacent to Sm ions rather than Gd ions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combined computational and experimental study”。；研究对象：稀土氮化物固溶体 GdₓSm₁₋ₓN，具体研究其电子结构、磁性行为（内交换场、矫顽场）以及氮空位缺陷的形成。

papers.title: A Unified Symmetry Framework For In-plane Anomalous Hall effect
papers.abstract: The in-plane anomalous Hall effect (IPAHE), driven by an in-plane net magnetization or an applied magnetic field, challenges the conventional anomalous Hall paradigm. Despite growing interest, a unified symmetry principle governing these phenomena has remained elusive. Here, we establish a comprehensive symmetry framework that bridges the spin space group, which dictates the magnetic geometry, with the magnetic space group, which governs the anomalous Hall response. We show that spontaneous IPAHE can emerge in ferromagnets when spin-orbit-coupling-induced spin-group symmetry breaking permits additional net magnetization directions. For field-induced IPAHE, we analyze how an applied magnetic field reduces the symmetries of all 122 magnetic point groups and identify 54 groups that support IPAHE. Our framework naturally predicts IPAHE in a broad class of unconventional magnets, including altermagnets and odd-parity magnets. In particular, symmetry analysis reveals characteristic one-, two-, or three-fold angular harmonics of the Hall conductance under an in-plane rotating field, providing a symmetry-resolved fingerprint for unconventional magnetism. Using this framework, we screen the MAGNDATA database and identify candidate materials supporting spontaneous or field-induced IPAHE, encompassing ferromagnets, antiferromagnets, and unconventional magnets. Finally, we validate the symmetry predictions through first-principles calculations for two representative materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有第一性原理计算验证）。判断依据：摘要中出现“symmetry framework”“symmetry analysis”“first-principles calculations”等关键词。；研究对象：面内反常霍尔效应（IPAHE），涵盖自发（由面内净磁化驱动）与场致（由外加磁场驱动）两类情形，研究对象包括铁磁体、反铁磁体、交变磁体（altermagnets）和奇宇称磁体等非常规磁性材料。

papers.title: Optimal Navigation on Simplicial Complexes
papers.abstract: The navigation time and optimal search strategies deriving from random dynamical processes on binary graphs have been extensively explored and analyzed, being of prominent interest in the network science field. In this work, we study an extension of these topological measures for simplicial complexes: a specific type of geometric and algebraic structures that encapsulates higher-order interactions. Here, the explorability analysis of simplicial complexes has been conducted in terms of the mean first passage times between nodes, i.e. the 0th-order simplices, with the inclusion of a long-range stochastic teleportation term modulated with respect to the local random walk hopping across the various dimensions. We also provide a perturbative approximation scheme recovering the modulation parameter between pure random walk and teleportation mode (for higher-order setting) acting as the expansion parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“随机动力学过程”“拓扑度量”“微扰近似方案”等理论分析关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：单纯复形（simplicial complexes）上的高阶相互作用网络，具体研究节点（0阶单纯形）之间的平均首达时间与最优搜索策略。

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单纯复形上，通过引入与各维度局部随机游走跳转相关的长程随机“传送”项，可系统分析节点间的平均首达时间，并建立微扰近似方案来刻画纯随机游走与传送模式之间的调制参数。；创新点：将原本针对二元图（binary graphs）的导航时间与最优搜索度量推广到单纯复形，从而纳入高阶相互作用；并首次提出在单纯复形上以传送项调制参数为展开量的微扰近似方案。

papers.title: Entropy production of active matter systems as indicator for computing performance
papers.abstract: Physical systems can process information through their natural dynamics, offering alternatives to conventional digital computing. Reservoir computing offers a basic framework by using a nonlinear substrate to map inputs into rich dynamical states read out by a simple linear layer. Active matter substrates are striking examples; they continuously consume energy and produce entropy. Theoretically, entropy production (EP) can describe the irreversibility and distance from equilibrium. But it remains unclear whether it can track computational capabilities. We address this conceptual gap by analyzing a driven swarm reservoir model. The system EP is computed from phase-space contraction and the bath EP from heat flow, separately, and put in direct association to prediction performance on a Lorenz-63 task. Via force parameter scans, we show that dynamical regimes with the strongest response to a driver as well as dissipation coincide with peak performance. Therein, the dynamical discrepancy between innate (minimal dissipation) and driven transferred heat (maximal dissipation) is sharpest. Generally, driver work and relative differences of driven and undriven EP closely mirror the performance landscape. The system EP, derived from a generalized Liouville-equation estimator, and heat flow provide complementary diagnostics and metrics, which are most robust in the best-performing regime. These results extend prior expectations that dissipation matters for computation by identifying when and how it becomes predictive. They also relate inference power to innate dynamics, pointing to generic principles for physical computing and where EP offers a screening metric for reservoirs and other base substrates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analyzing a driven swarm reservoir model”，并通过“force parameter scans”进行数值扫描分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：主动物质（active matter）系统，具体为一种受驱动的群集（swarm）储层计算模型，并以其作为非线性物理基底执行Lorenz-63时间序列预测任务。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 主动物质系统的熵产生（EP）及其与驱动相关的耗散特征能够作为计算性能的预测指标：在驱动响应最强、耗散最大的动力学区域，系统对Lorenz-63任务的预测性能达到峰值；驱动与未驱动状态下熵产生的相对差异与性能景观高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：主动物质系统的熵产生（EP）及其与驱动相关的耗散特征能够作为计算性能的预测指标：在驱动响应最强、耗散最大的动力学区域，系统对Lorenz-63任务的预测性能达到峰值；驱动与未驱动状态下熵产生的相对差异与性能景观高度吻合。；创新点：首次将系统熵产生与浴熵产生作为独立的诊断指标，直接关联到主动物质储层计算的计算性能，并明确了熵产生在何种条件下（最佳性能区域）以及如何（通过驱动与未驱动状态的相对差异）成为预测计算能力的筛选指标，从而将“耗散与计算相关”的既有预期推进到可量化的预测层面。

papers.title: Boundary Kerr Signatures of the Interband-Coherence Hall Effect
papers.abstract: We identify a Hall response carried by optically induced interband coherence rather than by a non-equilibrium band population. In a weakly doped zinc-blende semiconductor, a longitudinal dc field drives a transverse flux of the conduction--valence coherence created by near-gap light. Angular averaging eliminates the homogeneous coherence density, while a lateral boundary converts the transverse flux into an antisymmetric, edge-localized, helicity-odd polarization. The resulting Kerr signal requires neither spin-orbit coupling nor a spin, valley, or orbital accumulation within an individual band. Within the eight-band Kane model, we derive the boundary kinetic equation and obtain a complex propagation length controlled by optical detuning and interband dephasing. The edge profile is monotonic at optical resonance and develops damped spatial oscillations away from it. The response is enhanced by electron--hole asymmetry and by strong interband mixing, making narrow-gap semiconductors especially favorable to observe the effect. These results establish dc-driven Kerr microscopy as a direct probe of an interband-coherence Hall effect and of multiband quantum kinetics in real space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We identify”“We derive”“within the eight-band Kane model”等理论推导表述，未提及实验数据或数值模拟。；研究对象：弱掺杂闪锌矿半导体中，由近带隙光诱导的带间相干性（conduction–valence coherence）在纵向直流电场驱动下产生的横向霍尔响应，即“带间相干霍尔效应”（Interband-Coherence Hall Effect）。

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无自旋轨道耦合、无单带内自旋/谷/轨道积累的情况下，纵向直流场可将光诱导的带间相干性转化为横向通量，并在样品边界形成反对称、边缘局域、螺旋度奇异的极化分布，从而产生可探测的Kerr信号。该信号由电子-空穴不对称性和强带间混合增强，窄带隙半导体最有利于观测。；创新点：首次提出由带间相干性（而非非平衡带内布居）承载的霍尔响应，并建立直流驱动Kerr显微术作为该效应的实空间直接探测手段，将多带量子动力学与边界效应联系起来。摘要未突出说明与已有霍尔效应研究的详细对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于八带Kane模型推导边界动力学方程（boundary kinetic equation），解析求解相干性的空间分布，得到由光学失谐和带间退相控制的复传播长度，并分析边缘轮廓（共振时单调、失谐时呈阻尼振荡）。

papers.title: A versatile generalized digital twin for Electron Microscopy
papers.abstract: Development of specialized imaging and spectroscopy states in transmission electron microscopy is needed for novel applications, such as flexible momentum-resolved high energy-resolution spectroscopy. This task is complicated by the need to align and configure many different lenses, and by ambiguity as to the locations of various imaging and diffraction planes, which are often not well documented. Here we develop a versatile digital twin for simulating the electron beam trajectory throughout an electron microscope. Our code package contains simple tools for modeling the microscope column, and we present multiple procedures for dialing in precise lens locations and calibrating lens models. This enables use of the model as a predictive tool, allowing the user to quickly and easily determine the correct lens values for setting up new condenser or projector modes. Automatic procedures to change lens settings and measure the resulting changes can be used to close the loop. With the accelerating development of machine learning and artificial intelligence tools, we also believe a physically-informed model of the microscope can serve as a valuable tool for automated microscopy and AI/ML integration.

papers.title: Layer- and Field-Dependent Magnetic Order in 2D CrSBr Revealed by Pulsed Nanocalorimetry
papers.abstract: Understanding the evolution of magnetic order in the two-dimensional limit remains a central challenge in van der Waals magnets, where thermodynamic measurements are constrained by the femtogram-scale mass of exfoliated flakes. Here, we use microsecond pulse-heating nanocalorimetry to measure the heat capacity and magnetic entropy of CrSBr flakes down to the monolayer limit. The measurements reveal the entropy landscape associated with magnetic ordering, uncovering a reduction of the interlayer transition temperature and an entropy-derived effective magnetic moment approaching the monolayer limit. Thermodynamic anomalies capture a crossover from bulk-like interlayer antiferromagnetism to a regime dominated by intralayer ferromagnetic correlations. A pronounced layer-parity effect further emerges, with odd-layer samples displaying an additional high-temperature contribution associated with uncompensated magnetic layers. Under in-plane magnetic fields applied along the easy axis, antiferromagnetic order is progressively suppressed, allowing extraction of a thickness-dependent critical field reflecting weakened interlayer exchange coupling. Entropy analysis further reveals an extended regime of magnetic fluctuations persisting well above the interlayer ordering transition. Together, these results establish nanocalorimetry as a powerful thermodynamic probe of low-dimensional magnetism, providing direct access to magnetic entropy, exchange interactions, and dimensional crossover in atomically thin van der Waals magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“微秒脉冲加热纳米量热法”进行测量，并描述了测量结果（“测量揭示了…”），属于典型的实验研究。；研究对象：二维范德华磁体CrSBr，具体研究其从块体到单层极限下的磁有序演化、层间反铁磁到层内铁磁关联的维度交叉，以及磁场对磁序的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过纳米量热法直接测量了CrSBr单层极限下的磁熵，揭示了层间转变温度降低、层数奇偶效应（奇数层出现额外高温贡献）以及磁场下反铁磁序被抑制的厚度依赖临界场，表明层间交换耦合随厚度减弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过纳米量热法直接测量了CrSBr单层极限下的磁熵，揭示了层间转变温度降低、层数奇偶效应（奇数层出现额外高温贡献）以及磁场下反铁磁序被抑制的厚度依赖临界场，表明层间交换耦合随厚度减弱。；创新点：首次将脉冲纳米量热法应用于二维范德华磁体的单层极限，实现了对磁熵和交换相互作用的直接热力学测量，为低维磁性研究提供了新的热力学探针。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 微秒脉冲加热纳米量热法（pulsed nanocalorimetry），用于测量飞克级质量薄片的比热容和磁熵；结合外加面内磁场（沿易轴方向）进行热力学测量。

papers.title: Sound attenuation and velocity shift in antiferromagnetic spin-1/2 chains
papers.abstract: We investigate ultrasound attenuation and sound velocity shift in antiferromagnetic spin-1/2 XXZ chains in magnetic field. We relate the sound velocity shift to derivatives of the free energy with respect to exchange interactions, permitting its calculation with integrability techniques at any temperature. Using bosonization, we predict the sound velocity shift exhibits a quadratic temperature correction at low temperatures in the Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid phase. Close to the fully polarized phase, a universal behavior associated with z=2 quantum criticality is found. In the Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid phase, ultrasound attenuation obeys a scaling law as a function of wavelength and temperature. An enhancement of attenuation is obtained near the fully polarized phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“bosonization”（玻色化）、“integrability techniques”（可积性技术）、“scaling law”（标度律）等理论方法关键词，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：反铁磁自旋-1/2 XXZ链在外加磁场中的声学性质，具体为声衰减（ultrasound attenuation）和声速偏移（sound velocity shift）随温度、波长及磁场的变化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Tomonaga-Luttinger液体相中，声速偏移在低温下呈现温度的二次方修正；声衰减满足关于波长和温度的标度律。在接近完全极化相时，声速偏移表现出与z=2量子临界性相关的普适行为，且声衰减得到增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Tomonaga-Luttinger液体相中，声速偏移在低温下呈现温度的二次方修正；声衰减满足关于波长和温度的标度律。在接近完全极化相时，声速偏移表现出与z=2量子临界性相关的普适行为，且声衰减得到增强。；创新点：首次将声速偏移与自由能对交换相互作用的导数建立联系，使得利用可积性技术精确计算任意温度下的声速偏移成为可能；并揭示了接近完全极化相时声衰减增强这一与z=2量子临界性相关的普适行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：1）利用可积性技术将声速偏移与自由能对交换相互作用的导数联系起来，从而可在任意温度下精确计算；2）采用玻色化方法分析低温Tomonaga-Luttinger液体相中的声速修正；3）通过标度分析研究声衰减的波长与温度依赖关系。

papers.title: Controlling Electron-Beam-Induced Charging in Colloidal Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: Colloidal quantum dots (QDs) are attractive nanoscale emitters, yet their cathodoluminescence (CL) response remains poorly understood and often unstable under electron-beam excitation, limiting CL spectroscopy and electron-beam-based device processing. Here, we investigate the CL mechanism and strategies to improve its stability using highly photostable, structurally homogeneous giant-shell CdSe/CdS QDs combined with in situ CL and photoluminescence (PL) measurements. By identifying distinct signatures of excited states in both lifetime and spectral measurements, we demonstrate that the CL response is governed by electron-beam-induced charging. Charge accumulation drives multiexciton generation even at relatively low currents, leading to a pronounced blueshift, shorter average lifetimes, and rapid cathodobleaching. To test this further, we employ indirect excitation to reach sub-pA currents beyond the limits of typical electron beams, showing that neutral-exciton emission can be partially recovered and cathodobleaching mitigated, although charging cannot be fully suppressed. Furthermore, by replacing long insulating ligands with shorter ones, we improve charge drainage and strongly suppress biexciton formation. Together, these results show that biexciton formation can be controlled by limiting charge accumulation, providing a practical route toward stable CL for spectroscopy, imaging, and electron-beam-compatible photonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“in situ CL and photoluminescence (PL) measurements”，以及“we employ indirect excitation”等实验手段。；研究对象：胶体量子点（colloidal quantum dots, QDs），具体为巨壳层CdSe/CdS量子点，以及电子束激发下的阴极发光（CL）行为与电子束诱导充电效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 胶体量子点的CL响应由电子束诱导充电主导：电荷积累即使在较低电流下也会驱动多激子产生，导致发光蓝移、平均寿命缩短和快速阴极漂白；通过缩短配体改善电荷泄放可抑制双激子形成，从而提升CL稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：胶体量子点的CL响应由电子束诱导充电主导：电荷积累即使在较低电流下也会驱动多激子产生，导致发光蓝移、平均寿命缩短和快速阴极漂白；通过缩短配体改善电荷泄放可抑制双激子形成，从而提升CL稳定性。；创新点：首次将CL不稳定性明确归因于电子束诱导充电驱动的多激子生成，并提出通过缩短配体改善电荷泄放来抑制双激子形成的实用策略，为稳定CL光谱和电子束兼容光子器件提供了可行路径。
papers.method_zh: 原位阴极发光（in situ CL）与光致发光（PL）联合测量，结合寿命（lifetime）和光谱（spectral）测量；采用间接激发（indirect excitation）实现亚皮安（sub-pA）电流；通过更换配体长度（长绝缘配体→短配体）调控电荷泄放。

papers.title: Resolving competing distortions in Ca0.4Sr0.6TiO3 using complementary electron and X-ray techniques
papers.abstract: We present a study of the perovskite Ca0.4Sr0.6TiO3 using variable temperature transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD). At room temperature and below, PXRD shows that the material adopts an orthorhombic Pbcm structure analogous to the P-phase of NaNbO3. Above 380 K the material transforms to a tetragonal I4/mcm phase. The structural distortions of these phases can be described as a combination of modes and order parameters associated with the M, T, $Δ$ and R-points of the Brillouin zone, each of which can be associated with a different set of superstructure reflections visible in X-ray and electron diffraction patterns. For the I4/mcm phase only the expected R-point reflections are observed in PXRD while both M and R- reflections are observed in electron diffraction. Using $Δ$ and R dark field TEM images we show that the phase transition proceeds by a loss of coherence of TiO6 octahedral tilting along the c-axis, leading to a microstructure of thin nanoscale platelets with a different local symmetry to the macroscopic structure. These persist well above the phase transition temperature and are probably responsible for the long-standing discrepancy between Raman spectroscopy and diffraction measurements in this materials system, as well as other secondary effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“transmission electron microscopy (TEM)”和“powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD)”等实验手段，并涉及变温测量。；研究对象：钙钛矿氧化物 Ca₀.₄Sr₀.₆TiO₃ 的结构相变及其竞争性晶格畸变模式，具体关注低温正交 Pbcm 相与高温四方 I4/mcm 相之间的转变机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料在 380 K 以上发生从正交 Pbcm 到四方 I4/mcm 的结构相变，但相变并非简单的对称性降低，而是通过 TiO₆ 八面体沿 c 轴倾斜相干性的丧失来实现，形成具有局域不同对称性的纳米级薄片微结构，这些微结构在远高于相变温度时仍存在，可能解释了 Raman 光谱与衍射测量之间的长期分歧。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料在 380 K 以上发生从正交 Pbcm 到四方 I4/mcm 的结构相变，但相变并非简单的对称性降低，而是通过 TiO₆ 八面体沿 c 轴倾斜相干性的丧失来实现，形成具有局域不同对称性的纳米级薄片微结构，这些微结构在远高于相变温度时仍存在，可能解释了 Raman 光谱与衍射测量之间的长期分歧。；创新点：通过互补的电子与 X 射线技术，揭示了该材料相变过程中宏观对称性与局域微结构之间的不一致性——即宏观衍射显示为单一对称性，而电子衍射和暗场成像显示存在局域纳米尺度对称性不同的区域，从而为 Raman 与衍射测量之间的长期矛盾提供了微观结构层面的解释。
papers.method_zh: 变温透射电子显微镜（TEM）和粉末 X 射线衍射（PXRD）；具体包括利用 Δ 点和 R 点暗场 TEM 成像来观察微结构，以及通过电子衍射和 X 射线衍射中的超结构反射来区分不同布里渊区（M、T、Δ、R 点）对应的畸变模式。

papers.title: Savi-Bhransha: Graph-Theoretic Dislocation-Loop Characterization in Crystals
papers.abstract: Dislocation loops govern the properties of crystalline materials, but extracting their detailed characteristics from atomistic simulations is difficult when loops are fragmented or embedded in compact defect debris. We present Savi-Bhransha, a graph-theoretic method that reconstructs interstitial and vacancy loops directly from local defect-displacement motifs, without constructing a global interface mesh. The method identifies Burgers-vector family, habit plane, loop size, segment-wise edge/screw character, and boundary and bulk defect populations for BCC, FCC, and HCP crystals. We apply it to single-cascade simulations over a range of energies in BCC W and HCP Zr, and to successive collision cascades in BCC W and FCC FeNiCr. We benchmark the method against the Dislocation Extraction Algorithm (DXA). Total dislocation lengths remain strongly correlated between the two methods, while Savi-Bhransha returns more stable loop-level objects in complex environments where DXA returns fragmented, overlapping open segments. Savi-Bhransha also better resolves mixed-morphology defects and dislocations near other defects, including vacancy clusters. Median runtime speedups are 6.34x for BCC W and 8.86x for HCP Zr, with peak-memory reductions up to 7.77x. In successive W cascades, the resolved boundary-defect concentration brackets transient-grating-spectroscopy measurements and the predicted Burgers-vector fraction agrees with room-temperature TEM. In FCC FeNiCr, the method resolves Heidenreich-Shockley dissociation, with a Shockley-pair signature in about 91% of surviving <110>-family interstitial clusters. Savi-Bhransha therefore enables efficient, topology-resolved analysis of large radiation-damage simulations and direct comparison with experimentally accessible observables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“graph-theoretic method”“atomistic simulations”“benchmark”“runtime speedups”等关键词，属于计算方法开发与验证。；研究对象：晶体材料中的位错环（dislocation loops），具体应用于BCC W、HCP Zr以及FCC FeNiCr合金中的辐照损伤（单级联与连续级联模拟）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于图论的位错环表征方法Savi-Bhransha，能够直接从局域缺陷位移模式重建间隙型和空位型位错环，无需构建全局界面网格。该方法在复杂缺陷环境中比DXA更稳定，且计算速度更快、内存占用更低，并能解析出与实验可观测物理量（如瞬态光栅谱、TEM）一致的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于图论的位错环表征方法Savi-Bhransha，能够直接从局域缺陷位移模式重建间隙型和空位型位错环，无需构建全局界面网格。该方法在复杂缺陷环境中比DXA更稳定，且计算速度更快、内存占用更低，并能解析出与实验可观测物理量（如瞬态光栅谱、TEM）一致的结果。；创新点：无需构建全局界面网格即可直接重建位错环，在复杂缺陷环境中（如碎片化、重叠、混合形态缺陷）比DXA更稳定；能解析Heidenreich-Shockley解离（约91%的<110>族间隙团簇呈现Shockley对特征）；计算效率显著提升（中位加速6.34x–8.86x，峰值内存降低至7.77x）。
papers.method_zh: 图论方法（graph-theoretic），从局域缺陷位移motif直接重建位错环；识别Burgers矢量族、惯习面、环尺寸、分段刃/螺位错特征及边界/体缺陷分布；与Dislocation Extraction Algorithm (DXA)进行基准对比；应用于BCC W和HCP Zr的单级联模拟及BCC W和FCC FeNiCr的连续级联模拟。

papers.title: Quasiparticle modes across soliton transition with density-dependent gauge field in optical lattices
papers.abstract: Tunneling of ultracold bosons confined in a one-dimensional optical lattice results in a nontrivial gauge field depending on density-difference between the sites involved. The density dependent tunneling (DDT) causes a first-order quantum phase transition from the Bose-Einstein condensate to the localized soliton. Here, we examine the low-lying quasiparticle mode evolution across the transition in the weakly-interacting limit. To this end, we employ the discrete Bogoliubov theory and dispersion curves to reveal an increase in the quasiparticle energies of dipole (and higher) excitations with DDT in the soliton phase while preserving the zero-energy mode. This is due to the decrease in effective tunneling, resulting in a larger energy cost to move the soliton, and causes faster dipole oscillations. The repulsive on-site atomic interaction further shifts the critical gauge field of DDT to a larger value by stabilizing the lattice soliton. The latter is corroborated by a phase diagram in the complex gauge field plane and mode energy gap of quasiparticles. We further show that the soliton does not exhibit Bloch oscillations as the effective momentum becomes density-dependent and deforms its internal structure. The dynamical response of the trap quench does not excite the width of localized wave-packet, and the breathing oscillations are suppressed. The latter two dynamical properties of the condensate uniquely contrast the soliton state due to the density-dependent gauge field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要中明确使用“discrete Bogoliubov theory”和“dispersion curves”等理论框架与数值分析手段，未提及实验测量。；研究对象：一维光晶格中具有密度依赖隧穿（DDT）的超冷玻色子体系，具体研究从玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）到局域孤子的量子相变过程及其低能准粒子激发模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱相互作用极限下，随着DDT增强进入孤子相，偶极（及更高阶）激发的准粒子能量增大，而零能模保持不变；有效隧穿的减小导致孤子移动的能量代价升高，从而引起更快的偶极振荡。此外，排斥性原子间相互作用通过稳定晶格孤子，将DDT的临界规范场推向更大值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱相互作用极限下，随着DDT增强进入孤子相，偶极（及更高阶）激发的准粒子能量增大，而零能模保持不变；有效隧穿的减小导致孤子移动的能量代价升高，从而引起更快的偶极振荡。此外，排斥性原子间相互作用通过稳定晶格孤子，将DDT的临界规范场推向更大值。；创新点：首次系统研究了密度依赖规范场诱导的BEC-孤子相变过程中准粒子模式的演化规律，揭示了孤子相中有效隧穿减小对偶极激发能量和振荡频率的调控机制，并发现孤子因有效动量密度依赖而抑制Bloch振荡和呼吸振荡，这些动力学特征与常规孤子态形成鲜明对比。

papers.title: Diode Effect in Nonlinear High-Kinetic-Inductance Transmission Line Resonators
papers.abstract: High-kinetic-inductance (HKI) transmission lines provide a promising platform for compact nonlinear superconducting microwave devices. Existing theoretical descriptions are typically based on the slowly varying envelope approximation, which becomes inadequate for strongly nonlinear resonant structures with pronounced spatial field variations. Here, we develop a theoretical framework for single-frequency nonlinear wave propagation in HKI transmission lines by formulating the problem as a boundary value problem that retains the full spatial dependence of the electromagnetic fields. Applying the method to resonant transmission-line geometries, we demonstrate power-dependent resonance shifts, bistable transmission solutions, and strongly direction-dependent transport arising from asymmetric impedance barriers, yielding transmission contrasts of up to $93\%$ without magnetic bias fields. The framework is further extended to a three-port stub geometry, where nonlinear interference produces shifted anti-resonances and Duffing-like spectral distortions. Our approach provides a versatile tool for the analysis and design of strongly nonlinear superconducting microwave devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a theoretical framework”“formulating the problem as a boundary value problem”“Applying the method to resonant transmission-line geometries”，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：高动能电感（HKI）传输线谐振器中的非线性微波传播现象，具体包括功率依赖的谐振频移、双稳态传输、非对称阻抗势垒导致的强方向依赖输运，以及三端口短截线几何中的非线性干涉效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强非线性HKI传输线谐振器中，通过保留电磁场完整空间依赖的边界值问题框架，预测了无需外加磁场即可实现高达93%传输对比度的方向依赖输运（二极管效应），并揭示了非线性干涉导致的频移反谐振和Duffing型谱畸变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强非线性HKI传输线谐振器中，通过保留电磁场完整空间依赖的边界值问题框架，预测了无需外加磁场即可实现高达93%传输对比度的方向依赖输运（二极管效应），并揭示了非线性干涉导致的频移反谐振和Duffing型谱畸变。；创新点：突破了传统缓变包络近似在强非线性谐振结构中的局限性，首次在HKI传输线谐振器中系统预测了无需磁场的强二极管效应（传输对比度达93%），并将框架推广至多端口短截线几何以描述非线性干涉效应。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将单频非线性波传播问题表述为边界值问题，保留电磁场的完整空间依赖，替代传统的缓变包络近似（SVEA）；应用于谐振传输线几何及三端口短截线几何进行解析/数值求解。

papers.title: Potential-defect-driven collective modes of one-dimensional two-component quantum droplets
papers.abstract: We examine a one-dimensional binary mixture of ultradilute quantum droplets in the presence of a central potential defect. The properties of the potential strength and the number of atoms exhibit distinct polarization transitions and low-lying ollective excitation spectra. The balance of (attractive) Lee-Huang-Yang quantum fluctuations and repulsive mean-field interactions results in a self-bound quantum droplet in a potential well. However, the potential barrier causes the polarization transition with the number of atoms, which is reflected in the excitation spectrum as a discontinuity and softening of the quasiparticle modes. We reveal that the critical number of atoms for the transition decreases as the attractive intercomponent interaction increases. Finally, the quench time dynamics of the interaction in potential barrier and well show the localization and diffusive fragmented droplets of two-component systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“examine”“excitation spectra”“quench time dynamics”等理论分析与数值模拟相关表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维双组分超稀量子液滴（binary mixture of ultradilute quantum droplets），在中心势缺陷（势垒或势阱）存在下的基态性质、极化转变、低能集体激发谱及淬火动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 势垒强度与原子数可诱导体系发生极化转变，该转变在激发谱中表现为准粒子模的不连续与软化；转变的临界原子数随组分间吸引相互作用增强而减小。势阱中形成自束缚量子液滴，而势垒/势阱中的相互作用淬火动力学分别导致局域化与弥散碎裂的液滴行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：势垒强度与原子数可诱导体系发生极化转变，该转变在激发谱中表现为准粒子模的不连续与软化；转变的临界原子数随组分间吸引相互作用增强而减小。势阱中形成自束缚量子液滴，而势垒/势阱中的相互作用淬火动力学分别导致局域化与弥散碎裂的液滴行为。；创新点：揭示了中心势缺陷（特别是势垒）驱动的一维双组分量子液滴极化转变及其在激发谱中的特征（不连续与软化），并系统研究了临界原子数对组分间相互作用的依赖关系；同时对比了势垒与势阱中淬火动力学的不同碎片化行为。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用一维双组分量子液滴模型，基于Lee-Huang-Yang（LHY）量子涨落修正与平均场排斥相互作用的平衡描述；通过求解低能集体激发谱分析极化转变，并利用含时演化（淬火动力学）研究势垒与势阱中的液滴时空行为。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如DMRG、GP方程等）。

papers.title: Emergence of Propagating Exciton-Polaritons in Hybrid Waveguide-van der Waals Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Integrating few-layer materials into photonic circuits is a promising concept for novel on-chip photonic applications. We incorporate transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) with femtosecond-laser-written surface waveguides, which are embedded in fused silica chips. Our novel low-temperature optical spectroscopy setup enables coupling to the waveguide and simultaneous focus from the top to the TMD layer for a distinct excitation and collection of micro-photoluminescence ($μ$PL) signals in several measurement geometries. Along these lines, we observe spectral changes of the A exciton for encapsulated TMD monolayers when capturing the $μ$PL signal propagating through the waveguide. Depending on the thickness of the encapsulation with hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), these changes manifest as energetic redshifts of the A exciton, or even a splitting of the A exciton into two components. We attribute this behavior to strong coupling of the waveguide mode and the exciton in the sample, giving rise to the formation of propagating exciton-polaritons. Our interpretation is supported by calculations for a simplified model of a slab waveguide in the vicinity of an exciton by using the transfer matrix method. Having proven to be a highly adaptable framework for the study of propagating polaritons, our experimental platform likewise holds great promise for harnessing the unique properties of exciton-polaristons in integrated photonic circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合了理论计算支持）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述“low-temperature optical spectroscopy setup”“micro-photoluminescence (μPL) signals”等实验手段，同时提到“calculations for a simplified model…using the transfer matrix method”作为理论佐证，属于实验为主、辅以计算的混合类型。；研究对象：集成在飞秒激光写入的熔融石英表面波导中的过渡金属二硫化物（TMDs）单层，以及六方氮化硼（hBN）封装的混合波导-范德华异质结构。具体物理现象为波导模式与激子强耦合形成的传播性激子-极化激元。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在封装TMD单层中，当通过波导收集传播的μPL信号时，A激子出现能量红移甚至劈裂为两个分量，该现象归因于波导模式与激子的强耦合，即形成了传播性激子-极化激元。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在封装TMD单层中，当通过波导收集传播的μPL信号时，A激子出现能量红移甚至劈裂为两个分量，该现象归因于波导模式与激子的强耦合，即形成了传播性激子-极化激元。；创新点：将TMD单层与飞秒激光写入的嵌入式表面波导集成，构建了研究传播性极化激元的可调平台，并展示了通过hBN封装厚度调控激子-波导耦合强度（从红移到劈裂）的能力。摘要未突出说明与已有波导-激子耦合平台相比的具体优势细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用低温光学光谱系统，实现波导耦合与顶部聚焦同时激发/收集μPL信号，并在多种测量几何下进行测量；理论上采用转移矩阵方法对“激子附近的平板波导”简化模型进行计算，以支持实验解释。

papers.title: Phoretic flow in a three-dimensional wedge geometry
papers.abstract: Understanding how chemically induced surface transport generates fluid motion in confined geometries is essential for the rational design of microscale pumping devices and active microfluidic systems. Here we develop a theoretical framework for chemically driven phoretic flows in a three-dimensional wedge geometry in the diffusion-dominated regime. We formulate both the diffusion and hydrodynamic problems using a Fourier-Kontorovich-Lebedev spectral representation, exploiting the translational invariance and radial structure of the wedge. Green's functions for the concentration field are derived for reflecting and mixed reflecting-absorbing boundaries, reducing to finite image-like sums or closed-form expressions for commensurate wedge angles. The resulting slip velocity is then used to construct the three-dimensional Stokes flow through the Papkovich-Neuber representation, yielding explicit spectral solutions for the velocity field. These results establish a Green's-function framework for phoretic pumping in wedge-shaped confinement and provide analytical benchmarks for numerical simulations of chemically driven transport in confined microfluidic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“theoretical framework”“spectral representation”“Green's functions”“analytical benchmarks”等理论推导关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：三维楔形（wedge）几何结构中的化学驱动趋流（phoretic flow）现象，即由化学诱导的表面输运在受限几何中产生的流体运动，属于微流控与活性物质输运体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了三维楔形受限空间中化学驱动趋流流动的格林函数理论框架，给出了浓度场与速度场的显式谱解，为楔形微泵浦器件的设计与数值模拟提供了解析基准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了三维楔形受限空间中化学驱动趋流流动的格林函数理论框架，给出了浓度场与速度场的显式谱解，为楔形微泵浦器件的设计与数值模拟提供了解析基准。；创新点：首次为三维楔形几何中的趋流泵浦建立了完整的格林函数解析框架，并针对可公度楔角给出了有限镜像和或闭式表达式，为受限微流控系统的数值模拟提供了解析基准。（摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比或应用验证。）
papers.method_zh: 采用Fourier-Kontorovich-Lebedev谱表示方法求解扩散方程与Stokes方程；利用楔形的平移不变性和径向结构构造浓度场格林函数（适用于反射及混合反射-吸收边界条件）；通过Papkovich-Neuber表示构造三维Stokes流，得到速度场的显式谱解。

papers.title: Mechanical isotropy of heterogeneous octahedral materials
papers.abstract: An octahedral network has been widely used as a fundamental building block for diverse architected materials. Here, we demonstrate that heterogeneous octahedral materials can achieve complete elastic isotropy at a critical constituent volume fraction, nearly independent of the constituent stiffness ratio. The anisotropy ratio, a, transitions from a > 1 to a < 1 at the critical constituent volume fraction, due to a change in the dominant deformation modes. Microstructural analysis reveals that the geometry and connectivity of the heterogeneous octahedral materials are very similar to those of heterogeneous materials constructed on combined simple cubic (SC) and body-centered cubic (BCC) lattices exhibiting opposite elastic anisotropy. More importantly, we demonstrate that varying the constituent volume fractions in the octahedral materials governs elastic anisotropy, similarly to tuning the BCC-to-SC composition ratio in the SC-BCC materials widely employed for designing mechanically isotropic architected materials. The mechanical isotropy of the heterogeneous octahedral materials is further assessed using 3D-printed prototypes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算/理论分析）。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、microstructural analysis、3D-printed prototypes。；研究对象：异质八面体网络材料（heterogeneous octahedral materials），即由八面体单元构成的多相/多组分架构材料，重点研究其弹性各向异性与力学各向同性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 异质八面体材料在某一临界组分体积分数下可实现完全弹性各向同性，且该临界分数几乎不依赖于组分的刚度比；各向异性比a在该临界点从a>1转变为a<1，源于主导变形模式的改变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：异质八面体材料在某一临界组分体积分数下可实现完全弹性各向同性，且该临界分数几乎不依赖于组分的刚度比；各向异性比a在该临界点从a>1转变为a<1，源于主导变形模式的改变。；创新点：揭示了异质八面体材料通过调节组分体积分数即可调控弹性各向异性，其机制与广泛用于设计各向同性力学材料的SC-BCC混合材料中调节BCC/SC比例类似，为八面体基架构材料实现力学各向同性提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 微结构几何与连通性分析（对比简单立方SC与体心立方BCC组合材料的各向异性特征）；3D打印原型实验验证力学各向同性。

papers.title: Beyond Stoner-Wohlfarth: Machine-Learning Models and Symbolic Regression of Hard-Magnet Properties
papers.abstract: Predicting the extrinsic properties from hysteresis loops of a magnetic grain, namely the coercive field, remanent magnetisation, and maximum energy product, from its intrinsic micromagnetic parameters is a central problem in permanent-magnet modelling. Established analytical models provide useful estimates but often neglect nonuniform magnetisation processes, whereas direct micromagnetic simulations are computationally expensive. In this work, we train machine-learning models on 12012 micromagnetic simulations of an idealised cubic grain, spanning broad ranges of the saturation magnetisation, exchange constant, and uniaxial anisotropy constant. Benchmarked against the analytical models on identical held-out data, the machine-learning models predict all three extrinsic properties with substantially lower errors. Symbolic regression recovers the Kronmüller form of the coercive field, with an effective demagnetising factor that depends on the material, and finds new closed-form expressions for the remanence and maximum energy product. Each law contains at most two fitted constants yet approaches the accuracy of the machine-learning models. We also investigate the inverse problem of recovering the intrinsic parameters from the three extrinsic properties. The saturation magnetisation and anisotropy constant are recovered accurately, whereas the exchange constant is not, because it influences the extrinsic properties only weakly. The trained models are released through the mammos-ai Python package, enabling thousands of candidate parameter sets to be screened in seconds rather than the hours or days required by direct micromagnetic simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“train machine-learning models on 12012 micromagnetic simulations”，以及“symbolic regression”，属于基于模拟数据的计算与机器学习建模研究。；研究对象：理想化立方体磁性晶粒（idealised cubic grain）的永磁体性质，具体包括从微磁参数（饱和磁化强度、交换常数、单轴各向异性常数）预测其矫顽场、剩磁和最大磁能积等外在磁性参数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 机器学习模型在预测磁性晶粒的三种外在性质（矫顽场、剩磁、最大磁能积）上显著优于已有的解析模型；符号回归恢复了Kronmüller形式的矫顽场表达式，并发现了剩磁和最大磁能积的新闭式公式，每个公式仅含至多两个拟合常数，精度接近机器学习模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：机器学习模型在预测磁性晶粒的三种外在性质（矫顽场、剩磁、最大磁能积）上显著优于已有的解析模型；符号回归恢复了Kronmüller形式的矫顽场表达式，并发现了剩磁和最大磁能积的新闭式公式，每个公式仅含至多两个拟合常数，精度接近机器学习模型。；创新点：首次将机器学习与符号回归结合用于永磁体外在性质的预测与解析公式提取，发现矫顽场表达式中有效退磁因子依赖于材料参数；并给出了剩磁和最大磁能积的新闭式表达式。此外，训练好的模型通过mammos-ai Python包发布，可实现秒级的大规模参数筛选，大幅提升计算效率。
papers.method_zh: 基于12012次微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）生成数据集，训练机器学习模型；使用符号回归（symbolic regression）提取解析表达式；与已有解析模型（如Stoner-Wohlfarth类模型）在相同留出数据上进行基准对比；同时研究了从外在性质反推内在参数的反问题。

papers.title: Weak-electrolyte diffusiophoresis for rigid colloids
papers.abstract: We develop a model for the diffusiophoresis of a chemically inert, rigid spherical colloid with fixed surface charge in a monovalent weak electrolyte, in which a neutral solute reversibly dissociates into ions. A weak far-field gradient is imposed in the neutral-species concentration. In the fast-reaction limit, local mass action and bulk electroneutrality determine the far-field ionic gradients, while the bulk zero-current condition determines the diffusion-potential gradient. We solve the coupled Nernst-Planck, Poisson and Stokes equations for arbitrary double-layer thickness, linearising in the gradient strength while retaining the nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann equilibrium. In the Debye-Hückel limit, the mobility consists of one half of the matched fully dissociated response and a finite-double-layer correction due to neutral-ion coupling; the correction vanishes in both the Hückel and Smoluchowski limits. Beyond this limit, numerical solutions for the representative systems reveal a branch-selective response as the surface potential magnitude increases. When the counterion is slower than the co-ion, dissociation-association weakens a retarding concentration-polarisation layer, allowing the mobility to exceed the fully dissociated value. When the counterion is faster, the response remains close to the one-half scaling set by mass action. This reaction-polarisation coupling cannot be reproduced by adjusting only the bulk ionic strength, and hence the Debye length, in a fully dissociated model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We develop a model”“We solve the coupled Nernst-Planck, Poisson and Stokes equations”“numerical solutions”等表述，属于理论建模与数值求解研究。；研究对象：刚性球形胶体在弱电解质中的扩散泳（diffusiophoresis）现象。具体体系为：表面带固定电荷的化学惰性刚性球体，悬浮于单价弱电解质中（中性溶质可逆解离为离子），在远场中性物种浓度梯度驱动下的输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Debye-Hückel极限下，弱电解质扩散泳迁移率等于完全解离体系响应值的一半，加上一个由中性-离子耦合引起的有限双电层修正（该修正分别在Hückel和Smoluchowski极限下消失）。超出该极限时，数值解显示响应具有“分支选择性”：当反离子比同离子慢时，解离-缔合过程削弱了阻滞性的浓度极化层，使迁移率可超过完全解离值；当反离子更快时，响应保持接近由质量作用定律决定的一半标度。这种反应-极化耦合无法通过仅调整完全解离模型中的体相离子强度（即Debye长度）来重现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Debye-Hückel极限下，弱电解质扩散泳迁移率等于完全解离体系响应值的一半，加上一个由中性-离子耦合引起的有限双电层修正（该修正分别在Hückel和Smoluchowski极限下消失）。超出该极限时，数值解显示响应具有“分支选择性”：当反离子比同离子慢时，解离-缔合过程削弱了阻滞性的浓度极化层，使迁移率可超过完全解离值；当反离子更快时，响应保持接近由质量作用定律决定的一半标度。这种反应-极化耦合无法通过仅调整完全解离模型中的体相离子强度（即Debye长度）来重现。；创新点：首次建立了弱电解质中刚性胶体扩散泳的完整理论模型，揭示了中性溶质解离-缔合反应与浓度极化层之间的耦合机制，并证明该耦合效应无法被完全解离模型通过调整有效离子强度所等效描述。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值求解。具体包括：在快速反应极限下，利用局部质量作用定律和体相电中性条件确定远场离子梯度，利用体相零电流条件确定扩散电势梯度；求解耦合的Nernst-Planck、Poisson和Stokes方程组，对梯度强度做线性化处理，同时保留非线性Poisson-Boltzmann平衡；在Debye-Hückel极限下解析求解，超出该极限时对代表性体系进行数值求解。

papers.title: Quadratic piezoelectricity from stacking-engineered interference in multilayer sliding ferroelectrics
papers.abstract: Designing nonlinear piezoelectricity requires suppressing the linear piezoelectric coefficient without extinguishing higher-order electromechanical response, yet a general and reconfigurable route remains lacking. Here we introduce stacking-engineered piezoelectric interference as such a mechanism in multilayer sliding ferroelectrics. Combining first-principles calculations with a generalized Ginzburg--Landau framework, we show that each interlayer gap acts as a local piezoelectric channel whose sign and magnitude are determined by stacking. Constructive interference between same-signed channels produces a linear-dominated response, whereas destructive interference between oppositely signed channels suppresses the linear coefficient while preserving a finite quadratic response. Representative MoS$_2$ and NiTe$_2$ multilayers approach the parabolic limit, with BAAC-stacked MoS$_2$ reducing the linear-to-quadratic crossover strain by a factor of 25 relative to CBA-stacked MoS$_2$. Experimentally accessible tetralayer MoS$_2$ sliding pathways further connect linear-dominated, quadratic-dominated and sign-inverted states. Here, we identify stacking-engineered interference as a design principle for programmable nonlinear electromechanics in layered materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合型文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）和“generalized Ginzburg–Landau framework”（广义金兹堡-朗道理论框架）。；研究对象：多层滑移铁电体（multilayer sliding ferroelectrics）中的非线性压电效应，具体以MoS₂和NiTe₂多层薄膜为代表体系，研究堆叠工程调控的压电干涉现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“堆叠工程压电干涉”机制：通过设计不同层间堆叠构型，使各层间压电通道发生相消干涉，从而在抑制线性压电系数的同时保留有限的二次（非线性）压电响应。BAAC堆叠的MoS₂可将线性到二次响应的交叉应变比CBA堆叠降低25倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“堆叠工程压电干涉”机制：通过设计不同层间堆叠构型，使各层间压电通道发生相消干涉，从而在抑制线性压电系数的同时保留有限的二次（非线性）压电响应。BAAC堆叠的MoS₂可将线性到二次响应的交叉应变比CBA堆叠降低25倍。；创新点：首次提出“堆叠工程干涉”作为可编程非线性电机电响应的通用设计原理，实现了对线性/二次压电响应的可重构调控（包括线性主导、二次主导和符号反转三种状态），为非线性压电设计提供了无需抑制高阶响应的新路径。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合广义金兹堡-朗道（Ginzburg–Landau）理论框架，对多层滑移铁电体的压电响应进行系统分析；并考察了实验上可实现的四层MoS₂滑移路径。

papers.title: Coalescence-induced alignment of anisotropic particles in drying sessile droplets
papers.abstract: Alignment of anisotropic particles strongly governs the functional properties of printed materials, yet most studies have focused on particle alignment in single evaporating droplets. In droplet- based printing, however, neighboring droplets can coalesce, generating rapid capillary flows that redistribute material and markedly affect the final morphology. Here, we use mesoscale simulations to investigate how droplet coalescence and subsequent evaporation jointly determine alignment and redistribution in sessile droplets with different contact angles and volumes. During the early stages of coalescence, the mean nematic order along the coalescence direction increases for all combinations of contact-angle and volume asymmetries of the droplets. At later times, the mean nematic order either continues to increase or decreases, depending on the droplet geometry. We derive a geometric scaling based on curvature and volume asymmetry and show that the simulation results collapse onto a master curve, identifying an effective geometric asymmetry parameter that governs the mean nematic order at the end of coalescence. During evaporation, the contact angle strongly influences how the coalescence-induced orientational structure is transferred to the final deposit. For small contact angles, the contact line remains pinned for a longer duration, better preserving alignment. In contrast, larger contact angles promote contact-line motion, which weakens alignment, as reflected by a reduced mean nematic order, while simultaneously generating stronger concentration gradients in the final deposit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“mesoscale simulations”（介观模拟）。；研究对象：干燥过程中位于基底上的液滴（sessile droplets）内各向异性颗粒的取向排列行为，具体涉及液滴聚并（coalescence）与蒸发过程对颗粒取向和再分布的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液滴聚并初期沿聚并方向产生平均向列序，其后续演化取决于液滴几何形状；蒸发阶段接触角大小决定聚并诱导的取向结构能否在最终沉积物中保留——小接触角更有利于保持取向，大接触角削弱取向但增强浓度梯度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液滴聚并初期沿聚并方向产生平均向列序，其后续演化取决于液滴几何形状；蒸发阶段接触角大小决定聚并诱导的取向结构能否在最终沉积物中保留——小接触角更有利于保持取向，大接触角削弱取向但增强浓度梯度。；创新点：首次系统研究了相邻液滴聚并（而非单一液滴蒸发）对各向异性颗粒取向排列的影响，并提出了一个有效几何不对称参数（effective geometric asymmetry parameter）来统一描述聚并结束时的平均向列序。

papers.title: Curvature-amplified angular localization of radially localized states
papers.abstract: We study a continuum Schrödinger particle on a surface of constant curvature subject to a radial random potential and a weaker angle-dependent perturbation. Exact angular-momentum decomposition reduces the rotationally symmetric problem to independent one-dimensional random radial channels. A positive radial Lyapunov exponent distinguishes radial Anderson localization from the circular probability profile imposed by symmetry. Projection of a narrow radial mode produces a disordered one-dimensional ring. For angular disorder that is stationary in physical arc length, the ring localization length grows as the inverse square of the perturbation amplitude. Equating this length with the geodesic circumference yields a shell-breaking radius that grows algebraically in flat space but as $2a\ln(1/\varepsilon)+O(1)$ on a hyperbolic surface of curvature radius $a$ and angular-disorder amplitude $\varepsilon$. Transfer-matrix and finite-ring calculations determine the crossover coefficient. Direct polar-grid calculations at the same angular energy as the ring model use unbiased tracking of the degenerate angular-momentum subspace across six independent radial-disorder realizations and quantify the validity of the single-mode projection. The noncommuting weak-disorder and flat-curvature limits establish a curvature-amplified crossover for this deliberately anisotropic disorder ensemble, rather than a generic metal--insulator transition on the hyperbolic plane.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“We study a continuum Schrödinger particle”（连续模型理论）、“Exact angular-momentum decomposition”（解析方法）、“Transfer-matrix and finite-ring calculations”（数值计算）以及“Direct polar-grid calculations”（直接数值模拟）。；研究对象：常曲率曲面（包括平坦空间和双曲曲面）上的连续薛定谔粒子，受到径向随机势和较弱的角依赖微扰。具体物理现象为径向安德森局域化与角向局域化的相互作用，以及曲率对局域化长度和“壳破裂”半径的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双曲曲面上，角向无序导致的环状局域化长度与微扰振幅的平方成反比，且壳破裂半径随微扰振幅呈 $2a\ln(1/\varepsilon)+O(1)$ 的对数增长，而在平坦空间中则为代数增长。这表明曲率会放大角向局域化效应，产生一种曲率增强的交叉行为，而非双曲平面上的通用金属-绝缘体转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双曲曲面上，角向无序导致的环状局域化长度与微扰振幅的平方成反比，且壳破裂半径随微扰振幅呈 $2a\ln(1/\varepsilon)+O(1)$ 的对数增长，而在平坦空间中则为代数增长。这表明曲率会放大角向局域化效应，产生一种曲率增强的交叉行为，而非双曲平面上的通用金属-绝缘体转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于：针对“各向异性无序系综”（径向强无序+角向弱无序），揭示了弱无序极限与平坦曲率极限的非对易性，从而提出一种由曲率放大的局域化交叉机制，区别于通常的双曲平面金属-绝缘体转变。

papers.title: Polariton-Assisted Inelastic Tunneling through a Quantum Well
papers.abstract: We investigate electronic transport through a doped quantum well strongly interacting with a photonic mode confined in a double-metal cavity. Using a nonequilibrium Green's function formalism, we derive compact expressions for the current valid for arbitrary collective light--matter coupling strengths exceeding the relevant loss rates. We show that cavity polaritons leave observable transport signatures when the carrier injection rate is smaller than the cavity-induced electronic broadening. In this regime, the current--voltage characteristics exhibit inelastic sidebands associated with resonant and anti-resonant polariton emission, which are strongly enhanced under resonant illumination. Our results provide a realistic route to detecting cavity-induced modifications of charge transport in semiconductor heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“nonequilibrium Green's function formalism”（非平衡格林函数 formalism）推导电流表达式，属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：掺杂量子阱与双金属腔中受限光子模式强耦合形成的腔极化激元（cavity polaritons）体系，具体关注该体系中的电子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当载流子注入速率小于腔诱导的电子展宽时，电流-电压特性曲线会出现与共振及反共振极化激元发射相关的非弹性边带，且这些边带在共振光照下显著增强，为实验探测腔诱导的电荷输运修正提供了可行途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当载流子注入速率小于腔诱导的电子展宽时，电流-电压特性曲线会出现与共振及反共振极化激元发射相关的非弹性边带，且这些边带在共振光照下显著增强，为实验探测腔诱导的电荷输运修正提供了可行途径。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于：在强耦合（耦合强度超过损耗率）且载流子注入速率受限的特定输运区间，首次给出了极化激元辅助非弹性隧穿的可观测输运特征（边带结构），并指出共振光照增强效应，为在半导体异质结中实验检测腔诱导输运修正提供了具体理论预言。
papers.method_zh: 非平衡格林函数（NEGF）形式主义，推导出适用于任意集体光-物质耦合强度（超过相关损耗率）的电流解析表达式。

papers.title: Scalar curvature density as a new invariant in thermodynamic geometry: metric dependence and critical exponents
papers.abstract: We compare two Ruppeiner metrics constructed under fixed volume and fixed particle number conditions ($g_{_V}$ and $g_{_V}$) by analyzing the scalar curvature $R$ and introducing the scalar curvature density $\mathcal{R} = \sqrt{|g|}\,R$ as a complementary geometric invariant. Three fluid models of increasing physical realism are considered: van der Waals, Lennard-Jones, and argon described by a multiparameter equation of state that correctly reproduces non-mean-field critical behavior consistent with the Ising universality class. We find that $R$ and $\mathcal{R}$ exhibit distinct critical scaling: $R \sim t^{-dν}$ is governed by the correlation length exponent, whereas $\mathcal{R} \sim t^{-(1+β)}$ scales solely with the order parameter exponent $β$, a result that follows analytically from hyperscaling and the Rushbrooke relation independently of the universality class. The $N$-metric consistently outperforms the $V$-metric in reconstructing the vapor-liquid coexistence curve away from criticality, and the four Widom lines defined by the minima of $R_{_V}$, $R_{_N}$, $\mathcal{R}_{_V}$, and $\mathcal{R}_{_N}$ display a characteristic fourfold structure reproduced across all three models. The loci where both representations yield identical geometric descriptions define two new objects: the Curvature Equality Curve (CEC, $R_{_V} = R_{_N}$) and the Curvature-Density Equality Curve (CDEC, $\mathcal{R}_{_V} = \mathcal{R}_{_N}$), with the CDEC enclosing a substantially larger region of the phase diagram in all cases. These results establish $\mathcal{R}$ as a meaningful complement to $R$ in thermodynamic geometry and highlight the nontrivial role of metric choice in the description of phase transitions and supercritical behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“thermodynamic geometry”“scalar curvature”“critical scaling”等理论分析关键词，未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：热力学几何中的标量曲率密度（scalar curvature density）这一新不变量，以及其在范德瓦尔斯流体、Lennard-Jones流体和氩气（多参数状态方程描述）三种流体模型中的临界行为与相图结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 标量曲率密度 \(\mathcal{R} = \sqrt{|g|}\,R\) 在临界点附近按 \(\mathcal{R} \sim t^{-(1+\beta)}\) 发散，仅由序参量指数 \(\beta\) 决定，而标量曲率 \(R \sim t^{-d\nu}\) 由关联长度指数控制；此外，固定粒子数（\(N\)-metric）在重建远离临界的气液共存曲线时优于固定体积（\(V\)-metric），且两种度规的相等条件定义了新的相图几何对象（CEC和CDEC）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：标量曲率密度 \(\mathcal{R} = \sqrt{|g|}\,R\) 在临界点附近按 \(\mathcal{R} \sim t^{-(1+\beta)}\) 发散，仅由序参量指数 \(\beta\) 决定，而标量曲率 \(R \sim t^{-d\nu}\) 由关联长度指数控制；此外，固定粒子数（\(N\)-metric）在重建远离临界的气液共存曲线时优于固定体积（\(V\)-metric），且两种度规的相等条件定义了新的相图几何对象（CEC和CDEC）。；创新点：首次引入标量曲率密度 \(\mathcal{R}\) 作为热力学几何的互补不变量，并证明其临界标度仅依赖于序参量指数 \(\beta\)（与普适类无关）；同时定义了曲率相等曲线（CEC）和曲率密度相等曲线（CDEC）两个新的相图几何对象，揭示了度规选择对相变与超临界行为描述的非平凡影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Ruppeiner热力学几何，比较了固定体积（\(g_{_V}\)）和固定粒子数（\(g_{_N}\)）两种度规下的标量曲率 \(R\) 与标量曲率密度 \(\mathcal{R}\)；采用三种流体模型（van der Waals、Lennard-Jones、多参数状态方程描述的氩气）进行解析与数值分析，并利用超标度关系（hyperscaling）和Rushbrooke关系推导临界指数标度。

papers.title: Photoemission insights into lanthanide-based crystals
papers.abstract: The interplay of strongly localized 4$f$ electrons with itinerant spd-valence states gives rise to a wide range of correlated phenomena and properties that place lanthanide materials at the focus of considerable research efforts. Beyond the bulk, their surfaces are of particular interest, where the reduced coordination, a modified crystal electric field, broken inversion symmetry in combination with strong spin-orbit coupling, and the emergence of surface states and resonances considerably reshape 4$f$-driven electronic and magnetic properties. This, in turn, enables novel functionalities of particular relevance for low-dimensional systems and their applications. This review summarizes how advances in photoelectron spectroscopies, together with improved crystal growth, have enabled detailed insights into bulk and surface phenomena of lanthanide-based crystals. After a brief overview of key developments from the 1970s to the 1990s, we discuss recent progress, focusing on systematic studies by the authors and collaborators that form a coherent line of research. These include the unveiling of $k$-resolved $f-spd$ hybridization, the formation and evolution with temperature of $f$-derived Fermi surface in Kondo lattices, layer-dependent 4$f$ magnetic anisotropy, the emergence of ferromagnetically ordered surfaces in systems with non-magnetic bulk ground state. This coherent line of research addresses core questions in the physics of 4$f$ systems and opens opportunities for engineering novel lanthanide-based architectures, including heterostructures and supramolecular complexes with novel physical properties and functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。依据：摘要明确说明“This review summarizes...”，属于对光电子能谱研究镧系晶体的系统性总结。；研究对象：镧系基晶体（lanthanide-based crystals），特别是其体相与表面的4f电子体系，涉及Kondo晶格、4f磁性各向异性、表面态与表面共振等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光电子能谱技术的进步结合晶体生长质量的提升，揭示了镧系晶体中k分辨的f-spd杂化、Kondo晶格中f衍生费米面的形成与温度演化、层依赖的4f磁各向异性，以及在体相为非磁基态体系中出现的铁磁有序表面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光电子能谱技术的进步结合晶体生长质量的提升，揭示了镧系晶体中k分辨的f-spd杂化、Kondo晶格中f衍生费米面的形成与温度演化、层依赖的4f磁各向异性，以及在体相为非磁基态体系中出现的铁磁有序表面。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其系统性研究覆盖了从体相到表面的4f电子行为，并提出了基于镧系材料构筑异质结构和超分子复合物的工程新途径。
papers.method_zh: 光电子能谱技术（photoelectron spectroscopies），包括角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）等，结合改进的单晶生长技术。摘要未明确提及具体计算方法或理论框架。

papers.title: Strength-degradation phase-field regularization of cohesive fracture: the antiplane case
papers.abstract: Phase-field approaches to fracture, initially designed as regularization of the Griffith model of brittle fracture, are now commonly viewed as gradient-damage models whose regularization length becomes a material property driving crack nucleation. One weakness of this approach is that the strength surface cannot be arbitrary: its shape is dictated by the elastic energy, and its magnitude by the regularization length. We focus on the antiplane version of the model introduced by Bourdin, Marigo, Maurini and Zolesi (arXiv:2506.22558), which handles crack propagation along unknown paths and nucleation governed by an arbitrary convex strength surface by degrading the strength instead of the stiffness. It can be interpreted as a regularization of softening plasticity in which localization bands obey an equivalent cohesive law set by the strength domain and the toughness, while the role of the regularization length, when small compared to the elasto-cohesive length, is purely numerical. Strength, stiffness, and toughness thus become independent material data, and limit analysis, perfect plasticity, cohesive fracture, and brittle fracture merge into a single variational framework. We derive closed-form solutions for a simple shear problem, propose a numerical scheme combining alternate minimization and conic programming, and numerically verify the equivalent cohesive law, its independence of the regularization, and the size effect governed by the elasto-cohesive length. A "surfing" simulation highlights the structure of the propagating crack while a re-entrant V-notch is used to show how the model bridges small-scale yielding, cohesive fracture, and brittle fracture without a priori hypotheses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确涉及“推导闭式解”“提出数值方案”“数值验证”等理论建模与数值模拟内容。；研究对象：反平面（antiplane）剪切条件下的黏聚断裂（cohesive fracture）相场模型，具体为Bourdin、Marigo、Maurini和Zolesi（arXiv:2506.22558）所引入模型的变体。该模型通过降低强度（而非刚度）来处理沿未知路径的裂纹扩展，并允许任意凸强度面控制裂纹成核。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型可视为软化塑性的正则化形式，其中局部化带遵循由强度域和韧性共同决定的等效黏聚律；当正则化长度远小于弹性-黏聚长度时，其作用纯粹是数值性的。强度、刚度和韧性因此成为相互独立的材料参数，极限分析、理想塑性、黏聚断裂和脆性断裂统一于同一变分框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型可视为软化塑性的正则化形式，其中局部化带遵循由强度域和韧性共同决定的等效黏聚律；当正则化长度远小于弹性-黏聚长度时，其作用纯粹是数值性的。强度、刚度和韧性因此成为相互独立的材料参数，极限分析、理想塑性、黏聚断裂和脆性断裂统一于同一变分框架。；创新点：与标准相场断裂模型（将正则化长度视为材料属性并驱动成核）不同，该模型通过降强度而非降刚度实现任意凸强度面的成核控制，使强度、刚度、韧性三者解耦为独立材料数据，从而将多种断裂与塑性行为统一于单一变分框架。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟相结合。具体包括：对简单剪切问题推导闭式解；提出交替最小化与锥规划（conic programming）相结合的数值方案；数值验证等效黏聚律及其对正则化的独立性，以及由弹性-黏聚长度控制的尺寸效应；通过“surfing”模拟展示裂纹传播结构，并用凹入V形缺口（re-entrant V-notch）演示模型在无需先验假设的情况下衔接小尺度屈服、黏聚断裂和脆性断裂。

papers.title: Origins of microwave losses in superconducting circuits made with silicon-on-insulator substrates
papers.abstract: Silicon-on-insulator technology is widely used to fabricate silicon based devices, from advanced transistors to photonic circuits or nanomechanical systems. Integrating low loss superconducting quantum circuits with silicon-on-insulator substrates enables to couple the advantages offered by the mature silicon technology to the exquisite sensitivity of superconducting circuits. The natural approach, inherited from research in superconducting microwave devices, is to use a substrate made with highly resistive silicon, known for its low level of microwave losses. In this work, using superconducting microwave resonators, we show that counterintuitively, standard resistivity silicon-on-insulator substrates perform better than high resistivity silicon-on-insulator substrates at cryogenic temperatures. In the latter case, the presence of a parasitic sheet conduction at the interface between bulk silicon and silicon oxide acts as the dominant loss mechanism. This parasitic sheet can be suppressed using substrates with intentionally induced traps. In such substrates, losses are ultimately limited by the dielectric losses of the silicon oxide layer. These substrates offer interesting perspectives for the development of superconducting nanoelectromechanical systems. First, the release, i.e. the removal of the silicon oxide, could be limited to the moving parts, thereby maintaining the mechanical integrity of the rest of the device. Additionally, such structure would enhance heat evacuation into the bulk of the substrate which is an issue in current devices such as microwave-to-optics converters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“using superconducting microwave resonators, we show that...”，属于实验测量与表征。；研究对象：基于绝缘体上硅（silicon-on-insulator, SOI）衬底制备的超导微波谐振器电路，重点研究其低温微波损耗机制，特别是不同电阻率SOI衬底（标准电阻率 vs 高电阻率）以及界面寄生导电层和氧化硅介电损耗对器件性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温下，标准电阻率SOI衬底反而比高电阻率SOI衬底表现出更低的微波损耗；高电阻率SOI衬底的损耗主要来源于体硅与氧化硅界面处的寄生片状导电层，而通过引入陷阱（traps）可抑制该导电层，此时损耗最终受限于氧化硅层的介电损耗。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温下，标准电阻率SOI衬底反而比高电阻率SOI衬底表现出更低的微波损耗；高电阻率SOI衬底的损耗主要来源于体硅与氧化硅界面处的寄生片状导电层，而通过引入陷阱（traps）可抑制该导电层，此时损耗最终受限于氧化硅层的介电损耗。；创新点：颠覆了“高电阻率硅衬底必然低损耗”的传统认知，首次系统揭示了SOI衬底中界面寄生导电层在低温下成为主导损耗机制，并提出通过陷阱工程抑制该损耗；同时指出这类衬底对超导纳米机电系统（NEMS）的潜在优势（如选择性释放氧化硅、增强散热），但摘要未明确说明与已有SOI超导电路研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超导微波谐振器作为敏感探针，通过测量谐振器的品质因子（或微波损耗）来表征不同SOI衬底在低温下的损耗特性；对比了标准电阻率与高电阻率SOI衬底，并通过在衬底中引入陷阱来验证界面寄生导电层的损耗机制。

papers.title: Domain-Selective Enhancement of Second Harmonic Generation in Monolayer MoS$_2$ via Ferroelectricity-Controlled Photodoping
papers.abstract: Hybrid heterostructures combining two-dimensional semiconductors with ferroelectric materials offer a versatile route to actively control light-matter interactions at the nanoscale. Here, we report all-optical, light-induced domain-selective control of second-harmonic generation (SHG) in monolayer molybdenum disulfide (MoS$_2$) integrated with periodically poled lithium niobate (LiNbO$_3$). Spatially resolved SHG imaging reveals a pronounced modulation of the nonlinear optical response of monolayer MoS$_2$ governed by the ferroelectric domain pattern of the underlying substrate. A strong SHG contrast is observed between domains of opposite polarization, with a marked dependence on both the excitation wavelength and the incident optical power. The comparison between ferroelectric domains that either enable or do not exhibit light-driven photodoping in the MoS$_2$ monolayer provides a direct assessment of the role of carrier density in the nonlinear optical response. We find that ferroelectric-polarization-controlled photodoping at the MoS$_2$/LiNbO$_3$ interface enhances the effective second-order susceptibility, $χ^2$, producing an increase in SHG intensity of up to ~70% under resonant excitation conditions. Ab initio calculations corroborate that charge doping modifies the electronic band structure of MoS$_2$ and strongly affects $χ^2$ in the resonant regime, providing microscopic support for the experimentally observed modulation. The results highlight the combination of light intensity and ferroelectricity as a powerful knob for band-structure modulation in 2D materials and reconfigurable nonlinear optical responses, opening pathways toward programmable frequency conversion, smart light modulators, and advanced nonlinear photonic functionalities in integrated hybrid platforms.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁电极化控制的光致掺杂可在共振激发条件下将单层MoS₂的有效二阶非线性极化率χ⁽²⁾增强，使SHG强度提升最高约70%，实现全光学、域选择性的非线性光学响应调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁电极化控制的光致掺杂可在共振激发条件下将单层MoS₂的有效二阶非线性极化率χ⁽²⁾增强，使SHG强度提升最高约70%，实现全光学、域选择性的非线性光学响应调控。；创新点：首次实现基于铁电畴图案的全光学、光诱导的域选择性SHG增强控制，将光强度与铁电性结合作为二维材料能带结构调控的新自由度，为可重构非线性光子器件提供途径。
